key_facts.reason_jp: 資本効率の向上及び株主還元の充実；市場評価の向上

summary_en: 1,200,000 shares acquisition authorized at ¥1,000M ceiling (1.49% of 80,520,639 ex-treasury shares), Aug 7–31, 2026, via open market purchase on TSE. Concurrent cancellation of 900,000 shares (1.11% pre-cancel) effective Sep 11, 2026. Stated rationale: capital efficiency and shareholder returns as part of sustained growth and mid-to-long-term enterprise value enhancement.
summary_jp: 発行済80,520,639株（自己株式除く）の1.49%相当、120万株を10億円上限で取得、2026年8月7-31日に東証で市場買付。同時に90万株（消却前1.11%）を9月11日に消却。理由：資本効率向上と株主還元充実。
tag_en: Buyback Init - 1,200,000 shares (1.49% S/O) - ¥1,000M - Open market - Aug 7–31, 2026; Cancel 900,000 shares (1.11% pre-cancel) Sep 11
